notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least X +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Dualcaster Mage.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage from exile by paying {2} reduced to Animar.
Repeat from step 3.
